scope_reason: Decides what the compared frame draws.

notes: The name is vanilla's own misspelling (Frustrum). Section culling is proven by the terrain scenes; I did not find an entity frustum test in the native entity path. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): entity frustum culling is conservative: drawing a culled entity adds no pixels. Formerly listed as missing: Entity-level frustum culling: RenderManager culls entities with this class before doRender; the native entity pass (raster_mobs.c raster_mobs_draw, raster_entities.c raster_entities_draw) applies only the living-entity render-distance range check and draws recorded entities unculled otherwise.
